question: Which country apart from India was declared a winner at the 2020 Online FIDE Chess Olympiad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia.**__

__
 
• **India, Russia** declared joint winners of the **2020 Online FIDE Chess Olympiad.**
 
• India and Russia were declared joint winners of the 2020 Online FIDE Chess Olympiad after the final was marred by internet disconnection last night.
 
• The international chess federation **Fide's president Arkady Dvorkovich **decided to award the gold medal to both teams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The FIDE Online Chess Olympiad was held for the** first time due to the coronavirus pandemic.**
 
• The first round of the final ended in a 3-3 draw with all six games finishing in a stalemate.
 
• This is the biggest team championship in chess as around** 163 countries took part in the online tournament.**​
